mainEntity.name: Why does employment residence basis matter in a work residency matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: In client terms, work and business routes depend on the real activity in Brazil, the structure around it, and documents that match the proposed purpose closely. In real cases, employment residence basis changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.
